title: Inbound Summer Exchange Programme
institution: City University of Hong Kong (CityU), College of Science
about: CityU College of Science summer research exchange, 14 June to 6 August 2027, registered as the 6-credit course CSCI4006 Summer Research Project for Science Students. Open to students of partner universities, who must be nominated. Application deadline 15 February 2027.
requirements: Full-time student at a CityU partner university for at least one academic year

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "CSCI4006 Summer Research Project for Science Students" → A010.07: "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."
"Summer Research Project" → A010.07: "Apply responsible practices for verification, attribution, citation awareness, confidentiality, and academic integrity when using AI in research activities."
